payload.participant: uuid — the participant taken out of the open combat, named by its initiative entry or by its token, when the command's target is the instance; when absent or null, the command's target is the participant, its entry or its token. The entry's partition is tombstoned (a soft delete) and nothing else is written: its token stays on the map, the order closes up by itself (orderIndex, derived), and a participant that holds the turn is refused — the caller sends table.nextTurn first, then this command, and the next living participant has the turn
